Title: Azure Sphere - Anatomy of a secured MCU

Body.Content:
Azure Sphere is an end-to-end solution that contains three complementary components that provide a secured IoT platform. They include an Azure Sphere microcontroller unit (MCU), an operating system optimized for IoT scenarios that is managed by Microsoft, and a suite of secured, scalable online services.

Microsoft provides over a decade of support for the operating system, as well as use of the security service for a single per-device fee to simplify business planning. Read more in our recent Anatomy of a secured MCU blog post.
